decision: D5-8 (user, 2026-10-21): warning threshold = the step 4 baseline median of the same measurement + 20%; memory is judged by the growth over a 100-battle run; warnings only, nothing is blocked. A row without a comparable baseline is reported, never called 'no regression'.

baseline.machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB, macOS kernel 25.6.0, NW.js 0.117.0 / Chromium 154.0.8037.58
baseline.method: Fresh ad-hoc package, 3 launches, 24 round battles + 6 map encounters; fast messages, isolated saves, no other test/build running. Window 816x624, DPR 2, frontmost throughout: zero skipped unfocused frames and positive battle/map frame samples in every run.
baseline.battleNote: Only these 30 battles feed comparable battle/action rows. Full-save scenarios are separate. The historical 3ba2be9 measurements at DPR 1 are retained as historicalMedian only.
